mentions.name: Luminum
mentions.description: This is a Raspberry Pi OS modification for kids that turns a Raspberry Pi into a dedicated at-home learning device. The core idea is a no-limit device at home dedicated to learning rather than games.
mentions.problem: There is a lack of a no-limit device at home that is dedicated to learning instead of games.
mentions.audience: Kids learning at home, starting with the builder's own child
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on Raspberry PI OS mod for kids - https://luminum.tech/ I have one user (my kid). The core of the idea is to have one no-limit device at home that is dedicated to learning and not games.
mentions.author: brisky
